usage: # Empty A placeholder for an empty result. ## Usage ```gx No projects Create your first project to start. New project ``` ## Do - Explain why the area is empty. - Offer the next action in `EmptyContent`. ## Don't - Do not use an empty state for an error. Use an alert. - Do not hide the primary action of the page. ## Keyboard This component is static. It takes no focus and has no key bindings.
